items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: The name 'Beverly' is mentioned exclusively by the [INTERVIEWER] ('Beverly was the one of those days.') The [INTERVIEWEE] does not respond to or acknowledge this mention, nor does the interviewee mention Beverly in any other context.

ctx.x: He's been there about 25 years. Quite a long time ago. 25 years. Yeah, about 25 years. Oh, I can't. I wish I had a new job coming here for that for I could be thinking of them. When Chris was here, she could remember all of them names. Well, what do you remember? Do you remember some places he played? Oh, well at that time they played out at the country clubs. They all closed up out there on the highway now.
Like on Jefferson, down in Jefferson. Yeah, okay. Beverly was the one of those days. Beverly was the one of those days.

Oh, and you want to think of something you can't. You can't think all the names of them places. I can't remember the days. There was a band that he played with besides the Desdune band. Some of the bands he played with. I don't know. Was that Desdune died, Angel? Yeah, Desdune died. Desdune died, yeah. And he played, well, all I can remember is playing with him out in Texas. Well, he was with honeycomb, the tenor player was his band. That's his brother, Matt Brown. Yeah, his brother. Mr. Steevio's band. I mean,…
